turn.user_message: How would you record each decision?
turn.context: Playbook §5, the third 'tell me more': how the facts are recorded, and which records must be tracked as they happen.

text: Each fact comes from a place your hospital already keeps it. Here are those places, and what each one holds.
One of them needs no IT work at all. That is the one-tap form on the ward phone.
chat.pointer: Flip the switches, or pick a set. See which automations can switch on.
chat.note: Start with what needs no link. Add the links one at a time.
prompts: What exactly does our IT team need?
Can we test one without the link?
What if some notes are on paper?

blocks.title: Where every fact comes from
blocks.deck: Four places hold the facts. Each automation lights only when every place it needs is switched on.

sources.name: One-tap form on the ward phone
sources.holds: Each discharge decision from the round

sources.name: Hospital software: billing and notes
sources.holds: Charges, doctors’ notes and medicines given

sources.name: The scan and lab report system
The pharmacy stock list
sources.holds: What was issued, and what is left

automations.name: Family and pharmacy told that evening
Running bill kept up to date
Summary drafted on the evening round
Final summary signed on a phone

blocks.condition: Which systems your hospital uses is still to be checked. These are the usual ones.
